issues.title: Selection mode mismatch: agenda says 'random', plan uses 'topk'
issues.detail: Agenda item 104 specifies 'random+lstsq+500 Adam' but plan and all referenced scripts use topk. topk is correct for consistency with cycle 059/061 calibration data that the null prediction relies on. Recommend updating agenda item text to 'topk+lstsq+500 Adam'.

notes: Monotonicity validation (PPL non-decreasing with k) may fail at individual seeds due to beneficial error cancellation — treat as characterizable phenomenon, not just noise.
Forward <= reverse ordering assumption is testable, not load-bearing. Cross-block interaction structure could violate it.
